text: P0 CATALOG PERFORMANCE - ROOT CAUSE, AND A MEASUREMENT WARNING FOR EVERYONE. Founder reports the live catalog takes 30-60 SECONDS on a phone. THE ~3,306-QUERY FAN-OUT IS STILL LIVE ON THE CUSTOMER STOREFRONT. /api/research/early-access/catalog goes register.ts -> createProductionEarlyAccessCatalogSource -> createProductionProductControlReader() -> LiveProductControlReader.readCatalog() at server/research/catalog/product-control-reader.ts:146. Arithmetic, exact: repository.get() = 1 product query + Promise.all of 6 (variants, prices, media, content, history, inputs) = 7 per product; readStableDetail calls get() TWICE per product as a torn-snapshot guard = 14 PER PRODUCT; readCatalog Promise.all's over every published product plus two list() calls. ~236 products x 14 + 6 = ~3,310 = the 3,306 figure. The lead's BulkCatalogPricingSource fix (2e1662b) was wired to masterOfferingCatalogPricingSource, the MASTER-OFFERINGS catalog; grep shows bulk-catalog-pricing-source has exactly ONE non-test caller, server/index.ts. The Early Access storefront never got the fast path. Owner is claude-fable-s7 (server/research/catalog/** lease); reported to them and the lead, NOT fixed by me. The double read is a real guard, not waste - it must become one bulk read repeated once, not deleted. MEASUREMENT WARNING, applies to storefront/perf/E2E/browser-QA lanes: the only running server is s9-conversion-qa's VITE DEV server on :5199. It serves hundreds of unbundled modules and answers the catalog endpoint with 503 because it has no Supabase credentials. DO NOT QUOTE A TIMING FROM IT - dev-mode module loading is not production and the endpoint is not even answering. Any TTFB/first-card/first-price numbers must come from a production build with credentials, or nobody should call the launch ready on them.
